answer: Reciprocity weighting is the only part that matters. Edge weight comes from traffic both ways, so a one-way fan of vouches is inert. Every unverified claim in the batch cuts the score, and rewards vest for 100 epochs, longer than most farms plan for. A dune of fresh addresses does nothing without back traffic. No cleverness survives the vesting schedule, and the lotus at the end holds nectar only for whoever kept a two-way record.
